skill.name: generating-images
skill.description: Turns text briefs and reference images into still images by selecting a suitable model, structuring prompts, and managing generation jobs.
skill.summary: Route image briefs to suitable models and generate structured, consistent results.
skill.author: supercmohq

security_audit.summary: All 40 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown inline-code markers or ordinary image-generation guidance. No shell execution, system reconnaissance, prompt injection, or data exfiltration behavior was found, but one safety concern remains in retry guidance after content-filter rejection.

remediation.issue: The safety rejection guidance recommends changing the triggering content and resubmitting without first distinguishing disallowed content from a benign false positive.
remediation.suggestion: Require policy evaluation before any retry, refuse disallowed requests, and permit revisions only when the resulting request is independently allowed.

semantic_findings.description: SKILL.md advises naming a stand-in for content that triggered a safety filter, changing clothing or setting, and resubmitting. Without requiring a policy check, this can facilitate iterative safety-filter circumvention.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The retry instruction is explicit and applies broadly to any safety or NSFW rejection. The adjacent portrait guide is safer, but this main workflow does not limit retries to independently allowed requests.

content.value_statement: Image briefs often fail when model choice and prompt structure do not match the visual task. This skill routes requests and builds detailed prompts for generation or editing.
actual_capabilities: Routes image requests by text, illustration, portrait, editing, and identity-preservation needs.
Builds model-specific prompts using included guides for five image model families.
Uses reference-image analysis to identify details that must remain fixed.
Structures prompts for posters, portraits, and cinematic stills.
Batches multiple image requests while repeating shared visual constraints.
Tracks pending generation jobs and returns image URLs and local paths.
limitations: It creates still images, not video or animation.
Commercial product photography is delegated to a separate skill.
Generated text, faces, and cross-image consistency still require review.
Transparent backgrounds are not supported by the documented models.

use_cases.title: Create campaign graphics
use_cases.description: Build posters, banners, thumbnails, and social graphics with controlled copy, hierarchy, color, and layout.

use_cases.title: Develop consistent portraits
use_cases.description: Generate or edit portraits while preserving facial features, wardrobe, lighting, and framing across a set.

use_cases.title: Plan cinematic concept art
use_cases.description: Turn a scene brief into a composed still with explicit camera, lens, lighting, materials, and color grade.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a simple image
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a [aspect ratio] image of [subject] in [setting]. Use [style], [lighting], and a [color palette] palette.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs one original still image.

prompt_templates.title: Design a promotional graphic
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a [format] for [audience]. Feature [subject]. Render "[exact headline]" and "[support line]" with [typography and placement]. Use [brand colors]. Include no extra text.
prompt_templates.scenario: A marketer needs a graphic with legible copy.

prompt_templates.title: Edit a reference image
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit the supplied image. Change [target element] to [new state]. Preserve [identity, geometry, colors, and other invariants]. Match [lighting and perspective].
prompt_templates.scenario: A user needs a controlled change to an existing image.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a consistent image set
prompt_templates.prompt: Create [number] images of [fully described recurring subject]. Keep [wardrobe, palette, lighting, and style] identical. Vary only [shot, action, framing, and aspect ratio] for each image.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced user needs a coordinated visual series.

output_examples.input: Create a square event poster with the headline FUTURE FORUM and a green geometric background.
output_examples.output: A square poster with a dominant FUTURE FORUM headline, high-contrast typography, exact green palette, deliberate margins, and no extra text.

output_examples.input: Turn this portrait into a flat editorial illustration while keeping the person recognizable.
output_examples.output: An edited portrait that preserves facial structure and clothing while applying controlled line weight, stepped shading, and a limited editorial palette.

output_examples.input: Make three cinematic stills of the same detective entering a station at night.
output: Wide exterior establishing shot with the recurring detective, wardrobe, rain, palette, and lighting fixed.
Medium entrance shot with the same identity anchors and only the framing and action changed.
Close interior reaction shot with consistent wardrobe, grade, atmosphere, and facial features.

best_practices: Provide exact on-image text, required aspect ratio, and reference images in the first request.
Repeat identity, wardrobe, palette, and lighting details in every request within a set.
Review generated copy, hands, faces, and preserved elements before accepting the result.
anti_patterns: Do not rely on vague adjectives when visible materials, lighting, camera, and composition can be specified.
Do not refer to the same subject indirectly across independent requests.
Do not resubmit a pending job because that can create a separately billed generation.

faq.question: Can this skill edit an existing image?
faq.answer: Yes. Supply the source image and state what must change and what must remain fixed.

faq.question: Which image models does it support?
faq.answer: It includes routing and prompt guidance for GPT Image, Nano Banana, Seedream, Flux, and Grok image models.

faq.question: Can it generate text inside images?
faq.answer: Yes. Keep copy short, provide exact wording and placement, and verify the rendered result.

faq.question: Can it maintain the same person across images?
faq.answer: It can improve consistency with references and repeated descriptions, but every generated frame still requires review.

faq.question: Does it support transparent backgrounds?
faq.answer: No. The included guidance recommends a flat background followed by downstream compositing.

faq.question: What happens when generation remains pending?
faq.answer: The skill reuses the existing job handle with job status checks instead of starting another billed request.
